description: NeurIPS 2026's style file neurips_2026.sty (2026-01-29, 'last revision: January 2026'), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from Formatting_Instructions_For_NeurIPS_2026.zip on media.neurips.cc, linked from the NeurIPS 2026 call for papers. One column on US letter: the style loads geometry and sets the 5.5in x 9in text block again with \newgeometry at \begin{document}, so it overrides a document's own geometry. preprint is the non-anonymous mode for arXiv: no line numbers, the footer says it is a preprint. final is not used, because final without a track option (main, position, eandd, ...) leaves \@trackname undefined at the first-page footer (neurips_2026.sty l.392-402). The style loads natbib unless given nonatbib, and sets \rmdefault to ptm and \sfdefault to phv (l.101-102). Under XeTeX the default TU encoding has no ptm or phv shapes, so the text falls back to Latin Modern with font warnings; the official template's [T1]{fontenc} line is left to the document.
